# GSGFs's blog

> GSGFs's personal blog, primarily in Simplified Chinese, with public posts about technology, life, and personal interests.

Canonical site: https://gsgfs.moe
Language: zh-Hans

For LLMs and agents:
- Prefer canonical URLs under https://gsgfs.moe.
- Published blog posts provide raw Markdown at the canonical post URL with `.md` appended, for example `https://gsgfs.moe/blog/example-post.md`.
- Do not assume draft, private, admin, or API content is publicly available.

## Primary Content

- [Home](https://gsgfs.moe/): Site entry page.
- [Blog index](https://gsgfs.moe/blog): Paginated list of published posts.
- [About](https://gsgfs.moe/about): Information about the site and author.
- [Sitemap](https://gsgfs.moe/sitemap.xml): Canonical discovery list for public pages.
- [Atom feed](https://gsgfs.moe/blog/feed.atom): Latest published posts with metadata and content.
